title: Create useExportHistory hook
action: Create src/hooks/useExportHistory.ts — a localStorage-backed hook that tracks export events.
implementation: Follow the useDraftCache pattern. Storage key: 'niko.export-history-v1'. Store array of { id: string, exportedAt: number, format: 'md'|'html'|'pdf', title: string, wordCount: number }. Export: recordExport(format, title, wordCount), getHistory() returning array sorted by exportedAt DESC, clearHistory(). Cap at 50 entries (FIFO eviction). Include unit tests in useExportHistory.test.ts.
